history.en: Merriam-Webster dates the first known use of applecart in this figurative sense to 1788. An early example attributed to historian Jeremy Belknap used the related wording overset the apple-cart while describing how a last-minute amendment nearly disturbed an important political agreement. This is an early surviving record, not proof that Belknap invented the expression.
history.zh: Merriam-Webster 把 applecart 這個比喻用法的最早已知記錄定於1788年。 歷史學家 Jeremy Belknap 的一個早期例子使用了相關形式 overset the apple-cart，描述一項臨時修訂如何差點破壞重要協議。 這只是目前可找到的早期書面記錄，並不證明 Belknap 創造了這個慣用語。

history.en: Today, upset the apple cart means to disturb a stable order or cause plans, systems or arrangements to go wrong.
history.zh: 今天，upset the apple cart 指擾亂穩定局面，或令原定計劃、制度及安排出現問題。

origin.memoryEn: One push can scatter every apple; one careless change can disturb an entire plan.
origin.memoryZh: 一下推撞可以令所有蘋果四散；一項不小心的改動也可以打亂整個計劃。
